name: mcp-bunny-pro

tools.name: import_video
tools.description: Import a video into a library by fetching it from a remote URL (Bunny pulls the file server-side — no local bytes needed). The headline ingestion path: give a public URL (or one plus auth headers) and Bunny downloads, transcodes and hosts it. Returns the created video object (use its `guid` to track encode progress with get_video).

libraryId.description: Video Library id. Optional when BUNNY_STREAM_LIBRARY_ID is set; otherwise required.

url.description: Publicly reachable URL of the source video to fetch.

title.description: Title for the new video. Defaults to the file name.

collectionId.description: GUID of a collection to place the video in.

thumbnailTime.description: Timestamp (ms) of the frame to use as the thumbnail.

headers.description: Optional HTTP headers Bunny should send when fetching the URL (e.g. auth).

tools.name: create_video
tools.description: Create an empty video object (step 1 of the direct-upload flow). Returns a video with a `guid` you then pass to upload_video to push local bytes. For URL ingestion use import_video instead.

libraryId.description: Video Library id. Optional when BUNNY_STREAM_LIBRARY_ID is set; otherwise required.

title.description: Title of the video to create.

collectionId.description: GUID of the collection to add it to.

thumbnailTime.description: Timestamp (ms) of the frame to use as the thumbnail.

tools.name: upload_video
tools.description: Upload the bytes of a LOCAL video file to an existing video object (step 2 after create_video). Reads the file from disk and PUTs it. For a one-shot import from a remote URL, prefer import_video.

libraryId.description: Video Library id. Optional when BUNNY_STREAM_LIBRARY_ID is set; otherwise required.

videoId.description: GUID of the video object created with create_video.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the local video file to upload.

tools.name: list_videos
tools.description: List videos in a library with pagination, free-text search, collection filter and ordering.

libraryId.description: Video Library id. Optional when BUNNY_STREAM_LIBRARY_ID is set; otherwise required.

collectionId.description: Only videos in this collection GUID.

orderBy.description: Sort order for results. Defaults to 'date' (newest first) on Bunny's side.

tools.name: get_video
tools.description: Get a single video's full details: encode status, available resolutions, length, storage size, captions and thumbnail. Poll this to track transcoding progress.

libraryId.description: Video Library id. Optional when BUNNY_STREAM_LIBRARY_ID is set; otherwise required.

tools.name: update_video
tools.description: Update a video's title, description, collection, chapters, moments (markers) or meta tags. `description` is a shortcut Bunny stores as a `description` meta tag — you don't have to build the metaTags entry yourself.

libraryId.description: Video Library id. Optional when BUNNY_STREAM_LIBRARY_ID is set; otherwise required.

videoId.description: GUID of the video to update.

description.description: New description. Shortcut that is written as a `description` meta tag (Bunny has no native description field); merged into metaTags, overriding any existing `description` tag.

collectionId.description: Move the video to this collection GUID.

metaTags.description: Meta tags as { property, value } pairs (custom key/values on the video). Replaces the video's existing meta tags. Prefer the `description` shortcut for descriptions.

tools.name: delete_video
tools.description: Permanently delete a video and all its encoded files. Irreversible.

libraryId.description: Video Library id. Optional when BUNNY_STREAM_LIBRARY_ID is set; otherwise required.

videoId.description: GUID of the video to delete.

tools.name: delete_videos
tools.description: Delete multiple videos in one call. Processes each id and returns which succeeded and which failed (with the error), so one bad id doesn't abort the rest. Permanent and irreversible.

libraryId.description: Video Library id. Optional when BUNNY_STREAM_LIBRARY_ID is set; otherwise required.

videoIds.description: GUIDs of the videos to delete (1..100).

tools.name: get_video_resolutions
tools.description: Get a video's resolution details: available, configured, playlist, storage and MP4 resolutions, plus storage objects and whether the original is kept. Read this before calling cleanup_resolutions to know exactly what can be reclaimed.

libraryId.description: Video Library id. Optional when BUNNY_STREAM_LIBRARY_ID is set; otherwise required.

tools.name: set_thumbnail
tools.description: Set a video's thumbnail to an externally hosted image URL.

libraryId.description: Video Library id. Optional when BUNNY_STREAM_LIBRARY_ID is set; otherwise required.

thumbnailUrl.description: Public URL of the image to use as the thumbnail.

tools.name: reencode_video
tools.description: Trigger a full re-encode of a video (e.g. after changing library encoding settings).

libraryId.description: Video Library id. Optional when BUNNY_STREAM_LIBRARY_ID is set; otherwise required.

videoId.description: GUID of the video to re-encode.

tools.name: repackage_video
tools.description: Repackage a video — regenerate its streaming playlists/DRM without re-encoding the source. Useful after toggling MediaCage/DRM on the library.

libraryId.description: Video Library id. Optional when BUNNY_STREAM_LIBRARY_ID is set; otherwise required.

videoId.description: GUID of the video to repackage.

keepOriginalFiles.description: Keep the previously generated files during repackaging. Default true.

tools.name: cleanup_resolutions
tools.description: Delete stored resolutions/original files you no longer need, to reclaim storage. Specify exact resolutions to remove, or let Bunny drop everything not in the library's config.

libraryId.description: Video Library id. Optional when BUNNY_STREAM_LIBRARY_ID is set; otherwise required.

deleteNonConfiguredResolutions.description: Delete any resolution not in the library's configured set.

deleteOriginal.description: Also delete the original source file.

deleteMp4Files.description: Also delete the generated MP4 fallbacks.

tools.name: get_video_heatmap
tools.description: Get the engagement heatmap for a video (which parts viewers watch/rewatch/skip).

libraryId.description: Video Library id. Optional when BUNNY_STREAM_LIBRARY_ID is set; otherwise required.

tools.name: get_video_statistics
tools.description: Get viewing statistics for a library or a single video over a date range: views, watch time and country breakdown. Omit videoId for library-wide stats.

libraryId.description: Video Library id. Optional when BUNNY_STREAM_LIBRARY_ID is set; otherwise required.

videoId.description: GUID of a video. Omit for library-wide stats.

hourly.description: Return hourly buckets instead of daily.

tools.name: transcribe_video
tools.description: Run AI transcription on a video to auto-generate captions in the given language, optionally also generating a title and description from the audio.

libraryId.description: Video Library id. Optional when BUNNY_STREAM_LIBRARY_ID is set; otherwise required.

videoId.description: GUID of the video to transcribe.

language.description: Target caption language code, e.g. 'en', 'pt'. Defaults to auto-detect.

sourceLanguage.description: Spoken language of the source, if known, to improve accuracy.

force.description: Re-run even if captions already exist for the language.

generateTitle.description: Also generate a title from the transcript.

generateDescription.description: Also generate a description from the transcript.

tools.name: add_caption
tools.description: Attach a caption/subtitle track to a video from a local .vtt/.srt file or inline text. Provide exactly one of filePath or captionsText.

libraryId.description: Video Library id. Optional when BUNNY_STREAM_LIBRARY_ID is set; otherwise required.

srclang.description: Language code of the caption, e.g. 'en', 'pt'.

label.description: Human-readable label shown in the player, e.g. 'English'.

filePath.description: Absolute path to a local .vtt/.srt file.

captionsText.description: Raw caption file content (VTT/SRT) as text.

tools.name: delete_caption
tools.description: Remove a caption track from a video by language code.

libraryId.description: Video Library id. Optional when BUNNY_STREAM_LIBRARY_ID is set; otherwise required.

srclang.description: Language code of the caption to delete, e.g. 'en'.

tools.name: get_play_url
tools.description: Build the embed/iframe and direct-play URLs for a video (computed locally — no API call). Optionally sign them with token authentication so the link expires: provide the library's Token Authentication Key (or set BUNNY_STREAM_TOKEN_KEY). Use this to hand a ready-to-use player link to a frontend after import/upload.

libraryId.description: Video Library id. Optional when BUNNY_STREAM_LIBRARY_ID is set; otherwise required.

sign.description: Produce signed, expiring URLs (requires a token security key). Default false.

expiresInSeconds.description: Lifetime of the signed URL in seconds (60..604800). Default 3600 (1h).

tokenSecurityKey.description: Library Token Authentication Key. Falls back to BUNNY_STREAM_TOKEN_KEY.

tools.name: get_video_play_data
tools.description: Get the full playback payload for a video from Bunny: playback URLs (HLS/MP4 fallbacks), captions, thumbnail, chapters and player settings. If the library enforces token authentication, provide a token security key so a valid token/expires pair is sent.

libraryId.description: Video Library id. Optional when BUNNY_STREAM_LIBRARY_ID is set; otherwise required.

expiresInSeconds.description: Token lifetime when signing (default 3600). Ignored without a token key.

tokenSecurityKey.description: Library Token Authentication Key. Falls back to BUNNY_STREAM_TOKEN_KEY.

tools.name: get_oembed
tools.description: Get the oEmbed metadata for a video (title, author, thumbnail and ready-to-paste embed HTML). Pass a videoId (the embed URL is built for you) or an explicit embed url.

libraryId.description: Video Library id. Optional when BUNNY_STREAM_LIBRARY_ID is set; otherwise required.

videoId.description: GUID of the video — used to build the embed URL.

url.description: Explicit embed URL, instead of videoId.

maxWidth.description: Max width hint for the embed.

maxHeight.description: Max height hint for the embed.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List collections in a library with pagination, search and ordering.

libraryId.description: Video Library id. Optional when BUNNY_STREAM_LIBRARY_ID is set; otherwise required.

orderBy.description: Sort order for results. Defaults to 'date' (newest first) on Bunny's side.

includeThumbnails.description: Include preview thumbnail urls for each collection.

tools.name: get_collection
tools.description: Get a single collection's details, including its video count and preview thumbnails.

libraryId.description: Video Library id. Optional when BUNNY_STREAM_LIBRARY_ID is set; otherwise required.

tools.name: create_collection
tools.description: Create a new collection in a library. Returns the collection with its GUID.

libraryId.description: Video Library id. Optional when BUNNY_STREAM_LIBRARY_ID is set; otherwise required.

name.description: Name of the collection to create.

tools.name: update_collection
tools.description: Rename an existing collection.

libraryId.description: Video Library id. Optional when BUNNY_STREAM_LIBRARY_ID is set; otherwise required.

collectionId.description: GUID of the collection to update.

tools.name: delete_collection
tools.description: Delete a collection. The videos inside are NOT deleted — they become uncollected.

libraryId.description: Video Library id. Optional when BUNNY_STREAM_LIBRARY_ID is set; otherwise required.

collectionId.description: GUID of the collection to delete.

tools.name: list_libraries
tools.description: List the Video Libraries on your bunny.net account (account API). Use this to discover the numeric `Id` you pass as libraryId / set as BUNNY_STREAM_LIBRARY_ID. Requires BUNNY_API_KEY.

includeAccessKey.description: Include each library's Stream API key in the response (sensitive).

tools.name: get_library
tools.description: Get one Video Library's settings: enabled resolutions, player config, storage/region, bound pull zone and (optionally) its Stream API key. Requires BUNNY_API_KEY.

id.description: Numeric id of the Video Library.

includeAccessKey.description: Include the library's Stream API key in the response (sensitive).
